name: Draws artwork, activates Box Selection, manipulates 8-handle Free Transform gizmo with rotation and RotSprite bake
description: Verify drawing a solid shape on canvas, selecting it with Box Select to reveal the 8-handle transformation gizmo with center pivot and animated dual-tone marching ants, rotating via corner rotation zone with 15 deg snap, scaling with aspect ratio lock, and committing with Enter to bake sharp RotSprite pixels.

planSteps.description: Verify the drawing studio workspace is loaded with center drawing canvas
Click the Ellipse tool button in the left toolbar (or press O)
Click on the center drawing canvas to stamp a shape
Select the Box Selection tool (press M or click Select Box in the left toolbar)
Click and drag a selection rectangle that completely encloses the drawn artwork shape on the canvas
Verify the interactive Selection Transform Gizmo appears mounted over the selection with 8 square handles, center pivot crosshair, and dual-tone animated marching ants
Hover over the outer rotation zone near the top-right corner handle and drag to rotate the selection by approximately 45 degrees
Verify the rotation angle badge updates in real-time and the canvas preview rotates sharply around the center pivot
Click the Flip H button on the floating transform HUD bar below the selection
Verify the floating selection flips horizontally
Press the Enter key or click the Apply / Commit button (checkmark) on the transform action bar
Verify the transformation bakes cleanly into the layer with crisp RotSprite pixel art alignment and no blurring
